source.title: The refined Tamagawa number conjectures for GL2
source.author_line: Chan-Ho Kim, with an appendix in collaboration with Robert Pollack

claims.selector: Theorem 1.1, PDF p.4, arXiv parsed lines 266-339
claims.statement: If the collection of central-critical Kurihara numbers is nonzero and the theorem hypotheses hold, the Bloch-Kato Selmer module structure is determined and corank_O Sel(Q,W_f^dagger)=ord(Kurihara collection).
claims.root_use: strong downstream discrete-to-Selmer exact classifier only

claims.statement: At good ordinary p>=5 with p-distinguished and large-image hypotheses, ord(Kurihara)=corank_O Sel and complex central vanishing order is congruent to Selmer corank modulo 2.
claims.root_use: parity is not an upper bound; analytic rank two remains compatible with Selmer corank 2,4,6,...

claims.statement: The equality ord_{s=k/2} L(f,s)=ord(Kurihara collection) is explicitly stated as the Beilinson-Bloch-Kato conjecture, not as a theorem.
claims.root_use: this is the exact generic complex-to-discrete order comparison sought by the R13 target cell

claims.statement: For weight-two newforms with analytic rank at most one and the stated hypotheses, Selmer corank, Mordell-Weil dimension, Kurihara order, and complex analytic order agree.
claims.root_use: solved low-rank analogue; DifferenceWitness blocks extrapolation to analytic rank two

claims.statement: If one Kurihara number at squarefree index n is nonzero, then corank_O Sel(Q,W_f^dagger)<=nu(n), the number of prime factors of n.
claims.root_use: a source-verified nu(n)=2 witness is an exact-rank-two upper-bound certificate when separately composed with a same-coordinate lower bound >=2

claims.statement: The paper presents Kurihara order versus complex Taylor order as an analogy before stating the theorem family.
claims.root_use: coordinate-faithfulness guard: analogy cannot be composed as equality

claims.statement: Quantitative local/Tamagawa correction identities are separately conjectural in the generality displayed there.
claims.root_use: keeps local/Tamagawa/leading-term glue separate from rank exactness

counterexample_first_checks.reason: Corollary 1.10 explicitly assumes analytic rank <=1; it cannot justify rank-two equality.
Corollary 1.5 supplies congruence modulo 2 only; rank two does not exclude higher even Selmer corank.
The generic complex/discrete equality is Conjecture 1.6.
Corollary 1.11 makes a concrete nonzero witness rigorous for that scoped object, but analytic rank two does not itself prove existence of such a two-prime witness.

scoped_composition.statement: If (i) an R9-compatible lower bound corank Sel>=2 is transported to the same weight-two Selmer object and (ii) there exists n with nu(n)=2 and nonzero Kurihara number in the Kim theorem cell, then Corollary 1.11 gives corank Sel<=2, hence exact corank Sel=2.
scoped_composition.not_proved: Exact complex analytic rank two generically implies existence of a nonzero two-prime Kurihara witness.
scoped_composition.coordinate_obligation: Bind the rational weight-two W_f(1) Selmer object to the exact E[p^infinity]/technical-prime object used in the Zhang R9 cell before crediting a full same-theory path.

negative_history: Do not relabel Conjecture 1.6 as a theorem.
Do not promote Corollary 1.10 beyond analytic rank <=1.
Do not treat p-parity as exact rank.
Do not treat computed Kurihara witnesses as generic analytic-rank-two proof.
Do not merge the R12 open-PR conclusion into scientific authority before its own gate status resolves.
